name: drupal/ckeditor_media_embed
description: Adds the Media Embed CKEditor plugins to Drupal.

suggest.vardot/ckeditor5-media-embed-drupal: The CKEditor 5 Media embed plugin library, as a drupal-library. Require the tag matching the CKEditor 5 version Drupal core bundles: ~47.6.2 for core 11.4.x. See composer.libraries.json.
